title: Goal Review & Refinement Practice
opening: A completed task is evidence about the work. It does not, by itself, show whether the goal is advancing. Review both what you did and what changed, then choose a review horizon that fits the question in front of you.

labels.review: Choose the review horizon that fits
labels.reviewIntro: Use a short review to prepare the next action. Use a wider review when you need to compare repeated practice, progress, obstacles, conflicts, changed conditions, or whether the direction still fits.
labels.shortTitle: A short review can prepare one action
labels.shortText: For example, if a lesson is ready but the source needed for tomorrow is missing, the next useful action may be to retrieve that source. This review answers what to do next; it does not claim that anyone learned or transferred the material.
labels.wideTitle: A wider review can test a pattern
labels.wideText: If a method is repeatedly practiced but the expected result is not appearing, compare the practice, result, delay and obstacles. The method may need examination. If conditions or commitments changed, also check for conflicts and whether the goal still fits.
labels.cadenceText: A fixed daily or weekly ceremony is not required when feedback already updates a stable routine. Review when it can answer a real question or change a relevant action, method, commitment, or direction.
labels.practiceIntro: Use the optional prompts to separate what happened from what changed and select a useful next review. You may save a partial note and return later.
labels.private: This optional private note is separate from the six required course questions.
labels.length: This full reflection is over 2,000 characters. Shorten it to save; all of your text stays here.
labels.sourceQuote:
Goal Review & Refinement Practice
Review both the work and its result. A short daily review can prepare the next
action. A weekly review can compare repetition, progress and obstacles. A wider
review can examine conflicts among goals, changed conditions and whether the
direction still fits.
labels.sampleLoaded: Hypothetical example loaded. Replace it with observations from your own goal when ready.

feedback.length: Shorten the full draft to fit the 2,000-character limit. Your text stays here.
feedback.conflict: This reflection changed elsewhere. Your answers remain here; compare the saved version before saving again.
feedback.readFailure: The saved note could not be loaded.

fields.label: What work did you complete or repeat?
What result changed or did not change? Keep the observation separate from the work.
What next action would a short review prepare?
What pattern, obstacle, conflict, changed condition, or fit question calls for a wider review?

example.work: Hypothetical only: I prepared three short practice sessions and followed the same routine each time.
example.result: I have confirmed that the sessions happened. I have not yet checked whether I can use the method in a new situation, so transfer is unknown.
example.shortReview: Before the next session, retrieve the missing source and choose one example to practice. That prepares the next action; it does not establish a learning result.
example.wideReview: If practice continues but the expected result remains absent, compare the method, feedback delay, measure and obstacles. If the schedule or commitments changed, check for conflict and whether the goal still fits.

source.assessmentBoundary: Six required open-ended questions remain separate from this optional private reflection. No gold answer or qualified semantic grade is supplied.
